newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam's official news agency opens in Washington.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam's official news agency opens in Washington.

text.p: The Vietnam News Agency (VNA), an official mouthpiece of the Hanoi government, said on Saturday that it had opened a bureau in the U.S. capital, Washington.
The agency, which generally sets the news agenda for the state-controlled domestic press, has around 900 journalists and now 18 offices outside the country.
Communist Vietnam and its old adversary, the United States, normalised diplomatic ties in July last year.
But despite the thaw in relations, Hanoi and Washington have not yet reached agreement on full economic and trade normalisation.
